tips.title: Dealing with Trumpeter Multi-Part Gun Barrels
tips.text: Trumpeter's multi-part gun barrels often need careful assembly. Dry-fit parts first, then apply Tamiya Extra Thin Cement at the join points. Use tweezers to gently hold parts together for 30 seconds. Avoid excess cement for a cleaner fit. After curing, gently clean up any excess cement with a hobby knife. Before painting, apply a light coat of Vallejo Airbrush Thinner to remove any remaining cement residue.

tips.title: Aligning ICM Wings with a Simple Jig
tips.text: For winged models like ICM's aircraft, use a simple jig for alignment. Cut two rectangular strips of cardstock, each slightly longer than the wing's root chord. Attach them to the wing roots using double-sided tape, ensuring they're parallel to each other. This jig helps maintain wing alignment during glue-up with Tamiya Extra Thin Cement. Remove the jig after 24 hours.

tips.title: Installing Eduard Photo-Etch Parts
tips.text: Eduard's photo-etch parts often need bending. Use Eduard's dedicated bending tool to carefully curve parts around a sharp edge. Apply a light coat of Vallejo Airbrush Thinner to the bending point before bending to reduce stress. After installation, use a fine brush and Vallejo Metal Color to paint over the bend, hiding any slight imperfections.

tips.title: Working with Clear Prop Models Resin Conversion Kits
tips.text: Resin kits like Clear Prop Models' often require cleanup. Remove any excess resin with a hobby knife, then sand seams with 400 grit sandpaper. For difficult-to-reach areas, use flexible sanding sticks. Once sanded, apply a thin layer of Vallejo Plastic Putty, let dry, then sand again with 800 grit. Wipe with Vallejo Airbrush Thinner before painting.

tips.title: Assembling Meng Workable Tracks
tips.text: Meng's workable tracks require careful handling. Dry-fit track links first, then use tweezers to apply a small amount of Tamiya Extra Thin Cement at each join point. Gently press links together, ensuring they're aligned correctly. After curing, gently flex tracks to ensure workability. Before painting, apply a light coat of Vallejo Airbrush Thinner to remove any excess cement.
